title: TriProbe: Defending Federated IDS against Composite Backdoors (ACSAC 2026 artifact)
description: Artifact for the ACSAC 2026 paper "TriProbe: Defending Federated IDS against Composite Backdoors": the defense, the composite-backdoor attacks, the federated simulation harness, one runnable script per paper claim, and the reference outputs the paper's numbers were computed from. The three public IDS datasets are not redistributed; see infrastructure/datasets.md.
